tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind every panel. Never put body text blocks directly on it without a surface; labels and nav text are fine.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, list containers, the selected nav item and inputs. The main ground for content.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Nested cards inside a surface, row hover, progress tracks, neutral tags.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: row dividers and card outlines. Carries no meaning, so it is not held to 3:1.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: checkbox and input outlines. At least 3:1 on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, names, primary text and icons on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, previews and nav labels on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text such as dates, counts and helper copy on canvas, surface and surface-sunken. The lightest ink that still passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder icons, disabled text and decoration on surface. Fails 4.5:1 by design: never use it for text a person must read.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and of selected or checked controls. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single brand hue (plum). Links, the highlighted tag, key data points; as text on surface, canvas and accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for accent tags and highlighted rows; pair with accent text.

tokens.name: tag-green-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the green category tag.

tokens.name: tag-green-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tag-green-bg.

tokens.name: tag-blue-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the blue category tag.

tokens.name: tag-blue-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tag-blue-bg.

tokens.name: tag-orange-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the orange category tag.

tokens.name: tag-orange-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tag-orange-bg.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Slate blue. Informational messages and neutral highlights; as a fill or as text on surface, canvas and info-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an info fill.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for info alerts and tags; pair with info text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Lagoon, a teal-leaning green. Confirmations and positive states; as a fill or as text on surface, canvas and success-soft. Leans towards blue so it stays distinct from danger for colour-blind readers. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a success fill.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for success alerts and tags; pair with success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Honey yellow. Fill only: warning badges, dots and banners, with on-warning text. Too light for text on light surfaces; use warning-ink for text.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a warning fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surface, canvas and warning-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for warning alerts and tags; pair with warning-ink text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Clay red. Errors and destructive actions; as a fill or as text on surface, canvas and danger-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for error alerts and tags; pair with danger text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px offset on every interactive element. At least 3:1 on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page heroes and marketing headlines. One per page.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Panel and card headers, names in list rows.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis within body text, button labels, subjects.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label; gap between stacked panels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding block; gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; row padding inline.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sidebar sections; app shell padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins and hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tags, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Nav items, nested cards, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and cards on canvas.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App shell, dialogs, large feature blocks.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons, avatars, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting panels and the selected nav item. Barely there: surfaces separate by tone first.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, floating toolbars.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the app shell floating on a backdrop.
